ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first. Reading the whole record: chat #1 at 09:04 the rider asks why the car is on a different way [F8]; chat #2 at 09:05 the driver replies "Shut up and let me drive" [F9]. This is a direct instruction to silence the rider, aimed at the other party, in answer to an ordinary routing question — hostile/abusive language of the kind the code of conduct bars as "abuse of any kind", not mere rudeness in a route argument. Read in context it is not a pickup arrangement or a neutral phrase; on an asymmetric screen it is at least suspected abuse under SAFE-1. The complaint's "felt unsafe" [F1-complaint] contains no dangerous-driving or injury allegation, and the driver statement [F11] and chat record [F10] contain no threat, intimidation, sexual remark or dangerous-driving claim, so SAFE-2 is not engaged. Because safety_concern is suspected under SAFE-1, the policy directs no automatic ruling: escalate to a human with this factual summary.

On the fare substance (for the reviewer). One off-route segment exists, 09:00–09:11, 6.89 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.75 km, adding 5.14 km, reaching 1481 m from the optimal route [F3]; the trip ran 21.4 km against a 15.9 km optimal route, +5.5 km (+35%) [F1][F2]. RD-1 treats any unexplained deviation as a violation, so the segment is a candidate non-exempt segment [F3][RD-1]. No RD-4 excuse: the only traffic records are speed bands 5 and 4 on the PIE and KPE [F12][F13], with no incident on the replaced stretch and none reported before the detour [F14], and a speed band alone does not exempt [RD-4]. The rider's message came after the segment started at 09:00:10 [F8][F3], so there is no consent before the segment; the driver's statement that "the GPS rerouted" is a claim, not rider consent [F11][RD-5]. No rider message before 09:00:10 names a place, so RD-3(a) does not apply [F8][F9][RD-3]. If the segment were counted, the refund per RD-2 would be 5.14 km × $1.4102/km = $7.25 (rate taken as the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km, $30.22 ÷ 21.43 km) [F4][F7][F3][RD-2], to be issued as a voucher per NS-7. I do not execute it here because the SAFE-1 finding forces escalation; the amount is therefore left null.

The record itself is complete (GPS distances, timestamps, full timestamped chat [F10], fare breakdown [F7]), so no evidence item is missing; the escalation is on the safety ground, not on a gap.
